cases.goal: Plan the Heron mobile 5.2 release work for this sprint under the team's rules

entries.text: - **Owner:** release captain for 5.2 is the platform squad.
- **Rule:** no feature lands after the 5.2 code freeze on 2026-11-14.
- Min supported iOS raised to 17 for 5.2 (was 16); Android stays at API 28.
- **Open:** crash on resume from background (issue #1187), cause unknown.
- Min supported iOS: 16.
- Analytics SDK pinned to tracker-sdk@3.8.2; 3.9.0 breaks offline batching.
- **Fixed:** crash on resume (issue #1187) was a stale auth token refresh; fixed in PR #1192, in 5.1.3.
- Store screenshots must be regenerated for every release that changes the home screen.
- 5.2 changes the home screen layout (new quick actions row).

cases.goal: Finish choosing the Pelican email delivery vendor and record the decision

entries.text: Shortlist for email delivery: vendor A, vendor B, vendor C.
Requirement: EU data residency and a signed DPA before any customer data is sent.
Vendor C dropped from the shortlist: no EU residency.
Trial results: vendor A 99.2% inbox placement, vendor B 98.7%.
Leaning towards vendor B on price.
Decision: vendor A, because the inbox placement gap outweighs the price difference; DPA signed 2026-10-06.
Migration plan: move transactional email first, marketing email a month later.
Vendor A sending limit on the starter plan is 50k emails a day; upgrade needed before marketing moves.
